title: Grave of the Fireflies
synopsis: An older brother, a younger sister, a candy tin of fruit drops, and a country that has run out of room for them.

nodes.text: A B-29 drone over a wooden city. The road still runs toward Mother's Hospital. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Run for the shelter” and choosing “Bury the rice.” In Air Raid Siren, the safer route is disappearing faster than the danger.

choices.consequence: You run for the shelter. The route to Mother's Hospital opens fast, while the margin for a second attempt disappears.
You choose to bury the rice. By Mother's Hospital, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.

nodes.text: Boys like you on a platform, ribs visible, a janitor sweeping past with a broom. You are unlikely to keep all three. The distance between The Candy Tin and Apology begins with the choice between “Sit down” and “Walk on.” A third choice, “Take the third path,” keeps Hill of Lights in play.

Some endings reveal themselves last. You commit to take the third path. It buys momentum toward Hill of Lights and spends the last protection hesitation gave you.

nodes.text: A janitor opens a tin and shakes the bones into the grass and you watch from somewhere that is not quite anywhere, and Setsuko comes to meet you. The road into The Candy Tin began with “Sit down” in Train Station; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You go back to your aunt's house with your head low and you survive the war by inches, and you spend the rest of your life writing a sister letters she will not read. The road into Apology began with “Walk on” in Train Station; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

Fireflies above the city, your sister's hand small in yours, the war over somewhere you will never need to go again. The road into Hill of Lights began with “Take the third path” in Train Station; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
